commands.command: targeted ZIP and native symbolication tests with -race

verifiedBehavior: A ZIP containing an ELF object and a Mach-O dSYM companion expands into two parsed debug objects.
Each archived object retains its own symbols and unwind table.
The HTTP Minidump path resolves the archived dSYM through a differently named module and parent Debug ID.
Malformed ZIP data yields no objects without failing ingestion.
Archive entries are bounded to 256 regular files and 128MiB of declared uncompressed content.
Breakpad, ELF, Mach-O, Debug ID and CFI regressions remain green.
